title: Reflexivity of polynomial-time reducibility
statement: Every language $L$ over the binary alphabet is polynomial-time Karp reducible to itself: $L\le_p L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the binary alphabet
replaced:
Every language $L \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ is polynomial-time Karp reducible to
itself: $L \le_p L$ [AB09, Exercise~2.9].
